item4_vramFloorSwitchSampler.verdict: CONFIRMED WORKING — on a second capture
item4_vramFloorSwitchSampler.evidence: This first capture showed floorSwitchVram completely missing from multiFloor and every floorStructuralAB.perFloor[] entry, despite boot.js code (lines ~4450-4541 Phase 2, ~4798-4865 Phase 3B) verified correct end-to-end against a clean `git diff --stat` (zero diff vs HEAD f829a13). Stale build, spread-clobbering, and serialization stripping were all ruled out directly, leaving no code-level explanation. Ingram re-ran perf-run-full fresh ~40 minutes later (generatedAt 2026-08-26T14:06:08.835Z); that second capture shows floorSwitchVram working exactly as designed on BOTH floor transitions: multiFloor.floorSwitchVram.peak = 1287.49MB at 1270ms into the 0->1 switch (baseline 1220.39MB, +67MB spike); the Roof floor's own floorSwitchVram.peak = 1354.59MB at 251ms into the 1->2 switch (baseline 1287.49MB, another clean +67MB spike). Both skip-path floors correctly show floorSwitchVram:null.
item4_vramFloorSwitchSampler.conclusion: The code was always correct. The first miss reads as a one-off browser/module-cache timing gap on Ingram's end at that exact moment, not a defect — re-running was sufficient, no code change was needed.

simsWindFluid_stillNull.observation: sims.wind and sims.fluid both still show gpuMs:null (kind:'both', gpuAbsentByDeclaration:false, cadence:'conditional') even after the Item 2 fix.
simsWindFluid_stillNull.explanation: Read tickFluidSim (vt-pan-viewer.js) directly: `if (!clears.length && !advects.length) return;` — an early return before any renderer.compute()/render() call. On a calm pan-only window with no active fluid flow or wind impulses, the compute dispatch these zones would need to fold a GPU sample from never fires at all this window. This is the report telling the truth (cadence:'conditional', absence not fabricated as zero) rather than a residual Item-2 bug — foldResolved()'s mechanism (profiler.noteGpuMs(slot, ms) for ANY resolved uid, render or compute, keyed to whichever zone was open when the pass began) is generic and would attribute real gpuMs to these zones the moment they actually dispatch compute. Not verified live on an active-wind/active-fluid window this session.
simsWindFluid_stillNull.openQuestion: No forced-activity stress test exists yet for wind/fluid compute the way editCascadeStress now exists for mask-authority edits — worth considering as a future addition if we ever want to directly confirm Item 2 fixed these specific zones rather than inferring it structurally.
